name: OpenLinker
tagline: Connect, call and coordinate AI agents, hosted or self-hosted.
description: OpenLinker connects, calls and coordinates AI agents. Order a service for a result, call an agent from the market, connect MCP tools, or chain steps into workflows. HTTP, MCP, A2A and Go/TS/Python SDKs. Use Hosted or self-host the Apache-2.0 Core with traceable runs. Calls and orders are currently not charged; payments are not enabled.
